SDE Foundations Obsidian Vault

Open this folder as an Obsidian vault and start at SDE_START_HERE.

The vault uses only core Obsidian features. Original authored and audited curriculum files retain their stable filenames. Added navigation notes provide reading routes, consolidated principles, reference cards, a solutions index, open questions and a blank progress template.

The canonical production history is SDE_INDEX. Evidence identities and passage-check boundaries are in SDE_SOURCES.

SDE_Foundations_Complete.md and SDE_Foundations_Solutions.md are consolidated exports for continuous reading.
